service.description:
A user's Today: their open tasks and activities (WetTask not complete, closed or cancelled; the purposes WepPhoneCall, WepEmail and WepToDo are the activities) and their events (WetEvent not cancelled; WepMeeting is a meeting) on which the user's party has a WorkEffortParty row in effect now that is not declined or unassigned, less those the user snoozed past now on that row (snoozedThruDate, snooze#UserTodayItem).
Days are those of the session's time zone: the user's UserAccount.timeZone once logged in, the server's for internal work with no user. The groups: - overdue: a task or activity due (estimatedCompletionDate, else estimatedStartDate) before the start of today. An event is never overdue. - dueToday: a task or activity due today, at any time of the day (a due date is a deadline for the day); an all-day event of today; a timed event that has started and has not ended. - laterToday: a timed event that starts later today. A task or activity with no date is not on Today (the task list has it). A timed event with no end lasts to the end of its start day; one that has ended is left out. Recurring events are not expanded here.
An item: {kind (task, call, email, todo, meeting or event), workEffortId, title, dueDate (a task or activity), startDate, endDate (an all-day event: the start of its first day and the end of its last), allDay, priority, statusId, assignees (the other Assignee parties [{partyId, name}], empty when it is just the user), record ({recordEntityName, recordId, recordName} of the work effort's record link: the record's own join, RequestWorkEffort or WikiPageWorkEffort, else the first WorkEffortRecord; null with none), canUpdate (a task or activity of which the user is an assignee or the owner, for Mark done and Reschedule through mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task), hasCallLink (false until calls), source (null)}. Each group is in order of its date, then priority, then title.
Then each service of sourceServiceNames (the today-source providers of the shell data, each a service name or {service, label}; it must be a get or find service) is called in a transaction of its own with userId, partyId, fromDate and thruDate (the start of today and of tomorrow) and returns items, a list of items of the same shape. Each source is a group of sourceGroups [{label, service, items}], its items' source set to the label. A source that fails, or answers no items list, is logged by name, left out and named in failedSources [{service, label, message}]; the rest are returned. The built-in items, records and assignees stand alone the same way.
approvalCount: the approvals waiting on the user (mantle.party.PartyServices.count#UserNotifications). countOnly: only the three groups, without records, assignees, sources and approvals (get#ShellCounts). Another user's Today (a userId or partyId not the current user's) only with authorization disabled.

parameter.name: sourceServiceNames
parameter.description: The today-source services: names, or maps with service and label

service.description: Hides a task, activity or event from the current user's Today until snoozedThruDate, tomorrow 09:00 in the user's time zone by default, on the user's own WorkEffortParty rows of the work effort in effect now: the work effort's dates and every other party's Today stay as they are. unsnooze shows it again. (An empty snoozedThruDate takes the default, as any blank parameter does, so unsnooze is its own flag.) Mark done and Reschedule are mantle.work.TaskServices.update#Task with statusId WeComplete or estimatedCompletionDate.
